tasks.title: Correct the edge tab and make note links intentional
tasks.objective: Replace the detached rail treatment with one branded physical-edge tongue and allow the existing inline Markdown note links to open only through safe Command-click, while preserving panel and card interaction owners.
tasks.outcome: Cue rests as a recognizable low-obstruction tab, and users can intentionally open web references without accidental navigation or lost card selection/edit semantics.
acceptance: One 18×88 tongue sits inside the unchanged 22×88 hit frame, flat at the physical screen edge and rounded only inward, with canonical Cue icon, secondary count, no chevron/full outline and no settled retracted shadow.
One Reveal Cue Button retains current accessibility and the panel state machine, timings, geometry, focus, Pin, multi-display and Reduce Motion contracts remain unchanged.
Left/light/count-zero, right/dark/count-two and opaque edge-context renders prove attachment, single contour, brand and transparent inward hit remainder.

The existing inline Markdown renderer opens bare, angle-bracketed and labeled http/https links only with Command held; case-normalized schemes are allowed and file/custom/javascript schemes fail closed.

Ordinary click retains card selection/edit semantics, Command+click does not also invoke card gestures, accessibility surfaces do not duplicate, and independent reviews plus deterministic checks pass.

verification.proves: The full deterministic suite preserves public panel, card and storage behavior.
Actual PanelRootView fixtures cover required physical-edge visual states.
Exact images, policy cases and independent review map to the combined acceptance.
